title: All Stacks to 67
description: Changes the maximum stack size of all stackable items from 64 to 67. Items that are normally unstackable (like tools, weapons, armor) remain unchanged. Works in singleplayer and on servers.
body:
Changes the maximum stack size of all stackable items from 64 to 67. Items that are normally unstackable (like tools, weapons, armor) remain unchanged. Works in singleplayer and on servers.
Versions: Fabric 1.21.1
